scope: Bounded simulated A2 learner audit: ten-minute phone session, original listening, scene comprehension and production scaffolds.

method.browser: Owned isolated Chromium context on a local existing build at 390×844 pixels; synthetic version-one progress only.

findings.trigger: Type a response and reveal a line in Original dictation, then tap the already-selected Original dictation button.
findings.before: The mode remains selected but its handler clears the response, transcript reveal and self-checks.
findings.change: Both selected source buttons now return without changing task state; an actual source change still resets its task.
findings.validation: Focused TypeScript and ESLint pass. Four final-build browser journeys verify both source modes preserve draft, reveal and self-checks in English and Italian at 320/390 pixels; an actual source change still clears its task.

findings.classification: Observed workflow limitation with a design inference
findings.observation: The ten-minute session shows two-minute warmup, five-minute core lesson and three-minute vocabulary; its listening/gist and speaking stages are absent. A chapter conversation-game shortcut remains available. The fifteen-minute layout exposes the scene and production stages.
findings.change: An optional collapsed bilingual routine in Private listening now guides prediction, a gist-first listen, replay of an uncertain detail, comparison with a revealed line, and a short spoken or written version with one changed detail. It uses the existing tab-local response box.
findings.limits: This offers an optional short practice sequence; it does not change the ten-minute daily planner, saved session layouts, scoring or completion evidence. Navigation to Private listening remains in More practice & materials.

positiveObservations: The A2 scene has a gist prompt before its hidden transcript, then a separate detail check.
The production scaffold asks the learner to fill, speak, change a detail, cover the frame and try again; an optional changed-story response has its own model and explicit self-checks.
The observed phone flows had no horizontal overflow, runtime errors or external/write requests; listening task content did not enter saved progress.

reference.title: Teaching L2 Learners How to Listen Does Make a Difference: An Empirical Study
reference.verified: Publisher abstract read on 2026-10-26. A semester-long French second-language classroom study with 106 participants compared process-guided listening against the same listening texts and repetitions without that guidance.

researchBoundary.designInference: Use a compact prediction, monitoring and comparison sequence as optional listening guidance. Adding a changed-detail retell is an application-design inference for connecting this workspace to speaking/writing practice; this cited listening study does not validate that retell feature.
notEstablished: The effect of this portal routine on Italian comprehension, retention or spontaneous speaking.
Whether a ten-minute solo phone session reproduces the benefits of semester-long teacher-guided classroom instruction.
The pronunciation quality or availability of a learner’s device speech service.

browserRegression.selectedSourceContinuity: Both sources preserve response, reveal and self-checks.
browserRegression.actualSourceChanges: Both directions clear the response, reveal and self-checks.
browserRegression.optionalRoutine: Collapsed initially, five readable bilingual steps and no horizontal overflow.
browserRegression.reload: Ephemeral response and disclosure state clear; saved progress remains byte-equivalent.
